name: list-item
title: List Item
description: Settings, contacts and inbox rows: icon tiles, avatars with presence dots, subtitles, values, badges, checks and chevrons, with a UIKit-style press highlight that fades in fast and out slow. ListGroup gives you the iOS inset-grouped card with headers, footers and separators that line up with the text.
summary: Settings, contact and inbox rows with a press highlight that fades in fast, out slow.
usage:
import { ListGroup, ListItem } from '@/components/ui/list-item';

<ListGroup header="Account">
  <ListItem icon="user" title="Profile" value="Amelia Hart" onPress={openProfile} />
  <ListItem icon="bell" title="Notifications" badge={3} onPress={openNotifications} />
</ListGroup>
behavior: Pressable rows get a UIKit-style highlight that fades in fast and out slowly, and a chevron by default. onLongPress is supported too.
Pressable rows are buttons labelled with the title, subtitle, value and badge count, with disabled and checked states. ListGroup and ListSection headers are headers.
Plain React Native views, so rows look the same on iOS, Android and web. ListGroup gives the iOS inset-grouped card on every platform.
props: One muted line under the title.
Longer muted text, clamped to numberOfLines.
Small text at the end of the title row, e.g. a time.
Built-in glyph (user, bell, lock, shield, mail, card, help, logout, moon, globe, star, trash, settings, heart, phone, wifi) or your own, drawn in a rounded tile.
White glyph on a solid tile, or coloured glyph on a soft tile.
Round avatar with initials fallback and presence dot.
Muted value text on the right.
Dot, count (99+) or short label pill.
Disclosure chevron; on by default for pressable rows without trailing / checked.
Any control on the right, e.g. a Switch.
Makes the row pressable with a fading highlight.
44 / 52 / 68pt minimum height; icons and avatars scale.
Hairline that starts past the leading slot.
Check, badge and default tile colour.
Style for the row; ListGroup / ListSection apply theirs to their root view.
Uppercase heading and muted note around the inset card.
Draw the inset hairline under the last row too.
